Healthy.title: Your Plant is Healthy!
Healthy.cause: No disease detected. Leaf is healthy.
Healthy.quick_tip: Maintain moist soil, ensure 6-8 hours of sunlight, and apply K44 fertilizer every 2 weeks after flowering.

Bacterial_Spot.title: Bacterial Spot
Bacterial_Spot.cause: Caused by Xanthomonas campestris bacteria, spreads through infected seeds and water splash.
Bacterial_Spot.quick_tip: Remove infected leaves, apply Copper Oxychloride (2-3 g/L), and avoid overhead watering.

Cercospora_Leaf_Spot.title: Cercospora Leaf Spot (Frogeye)
Cercospora_Leaf_Spot.cause: Fungus Cercospora capsici, spread by wind and rain splash, thrives in high humidity.
Cercospora_Leaf_Spot.quick_tip: Remove and burn infected leaves, apply Mancozeb (2-2.5 g/L) every 7-10 days.

Curl_Virus.title: Chili Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuv)
Curl_Virus.cause: Transmitted by Whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci), common in warm dry weather.
Curl_Virus.quick_tip: Uproot and burn infected plants, control whiteflies with Neem Oil Spray (3-5 ml/L).

Nutrition_Deficiency.title: Nutrition Deficiency
Nutrition_Deficiency.cause: Lack of Nitrogen, Phosphorus, or Potassium; soil pH imbalance.
Nutrition_Deficiency.quick_tip: Apply balanced NPK fertilizer every 2 weeks and test soil pH.

White_Spot.title: White Spot Disease
White_Spot.cause: Often fungal (e.g., Oidium spp.), thrives in high humidity with low light.
White_Spot.quick_tip: Improve air circulation, apply Wettable Sulfur (2 g/L), stop overhead irrigation.
